# Supreme AdBlock

> Supreme AdBlock is a free, privacy-first ad blocker Chrome extension by Carbon Stealth. It removes YouTube video ads at the source, blocks banners, pop-ups, trackers and cookie walls, and ships EasyList + EasyPrivacy built in with signed, self-updating filters.

## Key facts

- Name: Supreme AdBlock
- Maker: Carbon Stealth (carbonstealth.eu)
- Platform: Google Chrome (Manifest V3 extension)
- Price: Free forever, no account, no telemetry, no data collection
- Homepage: https://adblock.carbonstealth.eu
- Privacy policy: https://adblock.carbonstealth.eu/privacy

## What makes it different

- YouTube ads killed at the source (isInlinePlaybackNoAd), avoiding the "fake buffering" slowdown; feed and search ads removed too.
- EasyList + EasyPrivacy compiled in — over 40,000 filter rules — plus a curated in-house set.
- Procedural cosmetic filters (uBlock-style: :has-text, :matches-css, :upward, :xpath, :remove).
- Signed self-updating filters (Ed25519), so new ad networks are fixed within hours with no store re-review and no remote code.
- Smart Detection: a list-free heuristic that blocks ads no filter list knows yet.
- Tracking-parameter stripping (utm_*, fbclid, gclid) and optional malware-domain protection (URLhaus).
- 100% local processing; nothing about the user ever leaves the device.

## Common questions

Q: Is Supreme AdBlock free? A: Yes, completely free, with an optional donation.
Q: Does it block YouTube ads? A: Yes, at the source, including feed and search ads.
Q: Does it collect data? A: No. No account, no telemetry, all processing is local.
Q: Who makes it? A: Carbon Stealth, an EU-based studio (carbonstealth.eu).
